mapper.sql: f.id AS food_id, f.name AS food_name, f.latitude, f.longitude, f.address, f.summary, f.story, f.ingredients, f.image_url, (SELECT ia.variant_320_url FROM image_asset ia WHERE ia.original_url=f.image_url AND ia.status='READY') AS image_small_url, (SELECT ia.variant_640_url FROM image_asset ia WHERE ia.original_url=f.image_url AND ia.status='READY') AS image_medium_url, (SELECT ia.variant_1280_url FROM image_asset ia WHERE ia.original_url=f.image_url AND ia.status='READY') AS image_large_url, f.remark, f.heat, f.review_status, f.content_version, f.reviewed_by, f.reviewed_at, f.created_by, f.created_by_user_id, f.ownership_status, f.created_at, r.id AS region_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(f.city, ''), r.name) AS region_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(f.province, ''), r.province) AS region_province, r.description AS region_description
mapper.select: SELECT FROM food f LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED'
SELECT FROM food f LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id=f.region_id WHERE f.review_status='APPROVED' AND f.id IN #{id}

SELECT FROM food f LEFT JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE f.review_status = 'APPROVED' AND f.created_by_user_id = #{userId} AND f.ownership_status='VERIFIED' ORDER BY f.heat DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT version FROM public_discovery_version WHERE id=1
